summary_1line: Krishna explains renunciation, the three gunas in knowledge/action/agents, duties by nature, and ends by urging Arjuna to surrender to Him and fight.

image_candidates.scene_text: Krishna stands as Arjuna's charioteer on the battlefield, instructing him while armies wait on the plain of Kurukshetra.
Arjuna bows with folded hands in the chariot, declaring his delusion destroyed as Krishna looks on calmly.
Sanjaya narrates to the blind king Dhritarashtra in the palace while envisioning the divine dialogue between Krishna and Arjuna.
